purpose: Provide explicitly separated estimates/proxies for residual V1 gaps without changing official fail-closed lanes.

JPY.reserve_balances.source: Bank of Japan official workbook Reserve balances row
JPY.reserve_balances.method: Use semantically exact official Reserve balances row as a proxy layer; do not claim original runtime provenance equivalence.

CHF.credit.source: SNB cube bakredinausbm best-matching official dimensional series
CHF.credit.method: Use the best identified official SNB series for direction/momentum only; absolute runtime equivalence is not claimed.

CHF.sight_deposits.source: SNB Data Portal sight-deposit source family best-matching official variant
CHF.sight_deposits.method: Use official candidate for direction/momentum only; absolute level mismatch is preserved and disclosed.

BRENT.market_proxy.source: ICE Brent futures settlement/market data when reproducibly connected
BRENT.market_proxy.method: Use ICE Brent futures strictly as a separate market-direction proxy; never substitute it for canonical EIA Europe Brent Spot Price FOB.
BRENT.market_proxy.activation_condition: A reproducible current ICE Brent futures observation source must be connected before numeric values are emitted.
